contexts.text: When it treats of vastation and desolation, it is said that they howl and cry; and it = that goods and truths are vastated.
To howl, to cry, to weep over him () = to pity and grieve.
So that men cry, and every inhabitant of the land howls () = a lack of all truth and good in the Church.
The two married partners then... began to wail.
To howl = grief on account of vastation. AE 435:7. AE 514:5. AE 539:6. AE 543:9. AE 637:8. AE 637:16. AE 652:21. AE 654:38. AE 695:24. AE 714:20. AE 911:13.
